package scope

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	jobs "github.com/plutoframework/pluto-jobs"
	jobspostgres "github.com/plutoframework/pluto-jobs/stores/postgres"
)

// Tx.Enqueue joins the business transaction: the delivery exists if and only
// if the transaction commits, carries the transaction's tenant and the
// declared budget, and only declared kinds are accepted.
func TestTxEnqueue(t *testing.T) {
	address := os.Getenv("PLUTO_CLI_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if address == "" {
		t.Skip("needs PLUTO_CLI_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, address)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	defer pool.Close()

	schema := "enq_" + strings.ToLower(jobs.NewID())
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA "+schema); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	defer func() {
		_, _ = pool.Exec(
			context.WithoutCancel(ctx), "DROP SCHEMA "+schema+" CASCADE")
	}()

	migration, err := os.ReadFile("../../db/migrations/005_jobs.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	settings, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(address)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	settings.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams["search_path"] = schema

	scoped, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, settings)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	defer scoped.Close()

	if _, err := scoped.Exec(ctx, string(migration)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	store, err := jobspostgres.New(scoped)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	enqueueAttempts["test.kind"] = 7

	defer delete(enqueueAttempts, "test.kind")

	open := func() (Tx, pgx.Tx) {
		raw, err := scoped.Begin(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		return Tx{
			scopeTx:     raw,
			scopeTenant: Tenant{scopeTenant: "org-a"},
			scopeJobs:   store,
		}, raw
	}

	count := func() int {
		var n int
		if err := scoped.QueryRow(
			ctx, "SELECT count(*) FROM pluto_jobs").Scan(&n); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		return n
	}

	tx, raw := open()

	if err := tx.Enqueue(ctx, "undeclared.kind", []byte(`{}`)); !errors.Is(
		err, ErrUnknownJob) {
		t.Fatalf("undeclared kind: %v", err)
	}

	if err := tx.Enqueue(ctx, "test.kind", []byte(`not json`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid payload accepted")
	}

	_ = raw.Rollback(ctx)

	tx, raw = open()
	if err := tx.Enqueue(ctx, "test.kind", []byte(`{"n":1}`)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := raw.Rollback(ctx); err != nil || count() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("rolled back enqueue persisted: %v %d", err, count())
	}

	tx, raw = open()
	if err := tx.Enqueue(ctx, "test.kind", []byte(`{"n":2}`)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := raw.Commit(ctx); err != nil || count() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("committed enqueue missing: %v %d", err, count())
	}

	var tenant string

	var attempts int

	if err := scoped.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		"SELECT tenant_id, max_attempts FROM pluto_jobs",
	).Scan(&tenant, &attempts); err != nil || tenant != "org-a" ||
		attempts != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("tenant/budget: %q %d %v", tenant, attempts, err)
	}

	if err := (Tx{}).Enqueue(ctx, "test.kind", []byte(`{}`)); !errors.Is(
		err, ErrNoTenant) {
		t.Fatalf("zero Tx: %v", err)
	}
}
